snapshot.text: State-run system moving to a state medical insurance model, rolled out region by region and planned nationwide by the end of 2026. Private hospitals can now deliver state-funded services.

priorities.title: State medical insurance
priorities.text: Medical insurance is to be introduced nationwide by the end of 2026, with World Bank support.

priorities.title: Free medicines for chronic diseases
priorities.text: Uzbekistan approved a list of free medicines for chronic and serious diseases.

priorities.title: Private hospitals in the state package
priorities.text: Private hospitals will offer state-funded medical services.
